Container.Name: adhx
Container.Overview: Your friends have better taste than the algorithm. A private feed of the best posts from X, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Reddit and nine more networks, saved by your friends and family. ADHX keeps a real copy of every post, finds them by what you remember, and sends the actual video to the group chat. First start: open the WebUI and enter the setup code from the container log (docker logs adhx | grep setup). Needs about 2 GB of memory.

Config.Name: WebUI port
Config.Description: Port for the ADHX web app.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: The database, the search models and every kept file. Put it on a share with room for your media.

Config.Name: Address (optional)
Config.Description: How people reach ADHX, e.g. https://adhx.example.com. Leave empty to use the address you set it up from.

Config.Name: Setup code (optional)
Config.Description: Choose the code that makes you the owner. Leave empty and read it from the log.

Config.Name: SMTP URL (optional)
Config.Description: Email sign-in links, e.g. smtps://user:pass@mail.example.com:465. Without it, links wait on the admin page for you to pass on.

Config.Name: Search threads
Config.Description: CPU threads for search by meaning. 1 on a busy NAS.
